messages.author: 61221ab1f726dce8
messages.subject: Installing a package from local repository
parts:
Hi,

I am running into difficulties installing a package (that isn't on CRAN) into my local repository. As suggested by http://rstudio.github.io/packrat/limitations.html, I created a ~/R/packages folder and then I installed the vimcom R package into the local repository like this:

download.file("http://www.lepem.ufc.br/jaa/old/vimcom_1.0-0.tar.gz", destfile = "vimcom_1.0-0.tar.gz")
install.packages("vimcom_1.0-0.tar.gz", type = "source", lib = '~/R/packages')

I was successful in doing this. Then in my project, I started R and loaded up packrat (0.4.2-1) and then proceeded to install this package.

library('packrat')
packrat::set_opts(local.repos = "~/R/packages")
packrat::install_local("vimcom")

This returned the following errors:

Installing package from '~/R/packages/vimcom'
Installing vimcom
'/home/fong/usr/local/lib64/R/bin/R' --vanilla CMD INSTALL '/home/fong/R/packages/vimcom'  \
  --library='/share/lustre/fong/projects/relapse_chl/packrat/lib/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/3.1.0' --install-tests

Error in pkg$package : $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors

I remember being able to do this in an earlier release of packrat, yet it is not failing. Any help would be appreciated.

Thanks,

    detach("package:vimcom", unload = TRUE)
    packrat::install_local("vimcom")

should then work for you.

On Tuesday, January 6, 2015 2:31:33 PM UTC-8, TinyHeero wrote:
Hi,

I am running into difficulties installing a package (that isn't on CRAN) into my local repository. As suggested by http://rstudio.github.io/packrat/limitations.html, I created a ~/R/packages folder and then I installed the vimcom R package into the local repository like this:

download.file("http://www.lepem.ufc.br/jaa/old/vimcom_1.0-0.tar.gz", destfile = "vimcom_1.0-0.tar.gz")
install.packages("vimcom_1.0-0.tar.gz", type = "source", lib = '~/R/packages')

I was successful in doing this. Then in my project, I started R and loaded up packrat (0.4.2-1) and then proceeded to install this package.

library('packrat')
packrat::set_opts(local.repos = "~/R/packages")
packrat::install_local("vimcom")

This returned the following errors:

Installing package from '~/R/packages/vimcom'
Installing vimcom

Error in pkg$package : $ operator is invalid for atomic vectors

I remember being able to do this in an earlier release of packrat, yet it is not failing. Any help would be appreciated.

Thanks,

Oh. This actually explains it. I actually load vimcom in my .Rprofile (this is needed for a vim r plugin that I used). So it is actually automatically loaded when I start R. I forgot about that.

Yes that fix works. Thanks for helping me with this.

On Tue, Jan 6, 2015 at 4:25 PM, Kevin Ushey <ke...@rstudio.com> wrote:
Oh, and I should mention -- the workaround would be to explicitly unload the package before install, e.g.

    detach("package:vimcom", unload = TRUE)
    packrat::install_local("vimcom")

should then work for you.
